title: logast messages.yaml
description: Optional. A message text per finding that needs one; left blank, the current or generated text stays. Then run logast apply .

additionalProperties.description: One finding (its id) and the texts it needs

^_.description: A hint logast writes (keys starting with _): keep it, logast finds the line again with it

^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$.description: The text for this slot (MSG: the message): plain words, no {} and no [k=v] (logast adds the values). Empty: nothing changes
examples: Refund sent to the payment provider
